values.value: Copies your NPSP General Accounting Units as funds, your NPSP levels as donor levels, and your NPSP recurring donations as recurring commitments of the same people and organizations, copies your NPSP engagement plans as stewardship plan templates, and ends with a parity report of NPSP levels and engagement plans against BarnCRM. NPSP itself is never changed.

[{"key":"rdBatch","text":"In NPSP Settings, Recurring Donations, stop the nightly Recurring Donations batch (Setup, Scheduled Jobs: delete the NPSP recurring donations job), so NPSP makes no more open installment Opportunities."},{"key":"levels","text":"Stop the NPSP Levels batch from moving donors between levels (Setup, Scheduled Jobs), so only BarnCRM donor levels change."},{"key":"gau","text":"Make your NPSP General Accounting Units inactive, so no new allocation is made to them."},{"key":"forms","text":"Point online giving and recurring payment processors at BarnCRM, so new recurring gifts are made only there."},{"key":"plans","text":"Stop applying NPSP engagement plans (remove them from NPSP Levels and from any flow or process that applies them), so new follow-ups come only from BarnCRM stewardship plans."}]
